records.boglNote: Plan lists MYRBETRIQ ER tablet 25/50 mg as Preferred Brand (P) and generic mirabegron ER tablet 25/50 mg (Myrbetriq) as Non-Preferred Generic (np), both with no PA/QL (PDF p.54, x=387 vs x=384). Legend (PDF p.3): 'most reference brand drugs (in parentheses) are not covered', so the brand is covered only because it is listed separately. AB rating is not printed in the document; generic mirabegron ER tablets are FDA AB-rated to Myrbetriq (FDA Orange Book, drug fact). Granules: generic np vs brand P as well.
